department: School of Computing and Data Science — Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science

deadline.value: Main Round deadline is December 1, 2026 (1st Clearing Round: April 30, 2027; 2nd Clearing Round: August 31, 2027).

gre_subject.value: Not required for STEM PhD programs (GRE Subject Test in Psychology >= 550 is required only for Department of Psychology applicants whose first degree is not in Psychology; GRE General/GMAT is required only for Business and Economics).
gre_subject.quote: Faculty of Business and Economics applicants are required to demonstrate their capability for graduate studies by obtaining satisfactory scores in the Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) or Graduate Record Examinations (GRE), taken within five years | Department of Psychology applicants whose first degree is not in Psychology are required to obtain a minimum score of 550 in the GRE’s Subject Test in Psychology taken within five years

supervisor.value: A tentative supervisor is appointed at commencement and pre-admission supervisor confirmation is optional.
supervisor.quote: At the commencement, a tentative supervisor will be appointed, though changes in supervision may occur during the early coursework phase.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible for Postgraduate Scholarships (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after confirmation, wef 1/9/2026), subject to funding availability, plus HKU-PS/HKPF fellowships.
funding.quote: Full-time students are eligible for financial support in the form of a Postgraduate Studentship (PGS) or part-time Demonstratorship, which carries with it some duties of conducting tutorials.

also.quote: The basic level of scholarship is HK$19,135 per month (wef 1/9/2026).

entry_route.value: Direct PhD admission is considered for applicants with a First Class or 2A honours bachelor's degree in Statistics or Mathematics, or a relevant research master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Direct entry to the PhD degree will normally be considered for students with (a) first class honours or 2A honours degree in Statistics or Mathematics from HKU or an equivalent institution, or (b) a research master's degree in Statistics, Probability and Actuarial Science.

notes: Includes Statistics, Biostatistics, Probability, Machine Learning, and Actuarial Science; HKU CDS also ran an early recruitment scheme closing 2026-08-31 for 2027-28 entry.
